title: Watch Roll Results
description: The generic watch table. Roll 1d6: 6 is Peace, 5-4 is Order, 3-1 is Nature.

outcomes.name: Peace
outcomes.description: A watch passing without a sighting of anything out of the ordinary.

prompts.text: An uneventful watch with time enough for a montage — useful for healing and repairs.
A meeting called by a crewmate or one of the undercrew, a chance to exchange information and make plans.
Time for a crewmember to spin a tall tale, letting another crewmate gain a whisper.
A stretch of calm worth breaking — strike up a tree-shanty to lift spirits and learn about the world.
Trouble among the undercrew: a fight, a sickness, or a personal discovery.
A quiet moment for reflection, confronting past actions and coming to terms with them. Usually heals mire.

outcomes.name: Order
outcomes.description: An encounter with one of the cultures living across the wildsea.

prompts.text: A ship passes within hailing distance — anything from a trading vessel to bug-fishers to pirates.
An outpost is discovered, likely supplying a nearby port: a drilling rig, farm, or refinery.
A survivor of some terrible disaster, stranded and waiting to be rescued.
A wreck or ruin, a remnant of past expansion, now abandoned and ripe for salvaging.
A cache of cargo or supplies, left by those trying to make the sea a little safer — or by smugglers.
A sign of conspiracy, hinting at an impressive secret or a shadowed truth.

outcomes.name: Nature
outcomes.description: An encounter with something born of the wild unknown, or a feature of the sea.

prompts.text: A change in the weather, affecting the sky above, the branches below, or both.
A natural feature of the rustling waves — useful for orientation when pathfinding and mapmaking.
A wonder of the waves, a sight that fills the crew with hope. Heals mire.
A horror of the wilds, an experience that leaves a lasting scar. Marks mire.
An unsettled place sturdy enough to moor your ship — landfall, and useful for finding resources.
A sighting of (or tussle with) the true wilds: a plant, a creature, or a force of nature.
